our_interpretation: In this economic discussion, the plain reading is a firm claim that monthly LLM subscriptions cannot sustainably cover service-delivery costs.
A subscription may have stated usage limits or included credits; the context itself includes such plans. Unlimited use is not required.
A fee that merely grants access to separately purchased usage does not by itself demonstrate the viability of bundled subscription usage.
I use January–March 2026, the latest completed calendar quarter before publication, to assess the ongoing state. Evidence of sustainability would also require a longer operating record.
No accounting basis or precise definition of economic viability is supplied.
criteria.support_condition: Broad, comparable plan-level evidence shows that monthly subscription receipts cannot sustainably cover delivery expenses under the plans' actual limits and customer usage.
criteria.contradiction_condition: At least one relevant monthly LLM subscription demonstrably and sustainably covers its delivery expenses from subscription receipts, without relying on separately billed usage to offset losses in the included allowance.
